deg_table.description: Path to DEG table CSV file.

pvalue_type.description: Whether to prefer nominal or adjusted p-value columns.

column_with_feature_id.description: Column containing feature IDs (e.g. gene names). Auto-inferred if omitted.

significance_column.description: P-value column name from the DEG table. Auto-inferred if omitted.

log2_fold_change_column.description: Log2 fold-change column name from the DEG table. Auto-inferred if omitted.

log2_fold_change_threshold.description: Minimum absolute log2 fold-change to be considered biologically significant.

choose_feature_to_label_by.description: Metric used to rank features for labeling.

number_of_features_to_label.description: Number of top features to label on the plot.

label_only_my_feature_list.description: If true, label only features in my_feature_list.

my_feature_list.description: Comma- or space-separated list of features to label.

top_genes_labeled_only_if_passing_thresh.description: If true, only genes passing thresholds are labeled.

label_force.description: Repulsion force for label placement (ggrepel force).

label_max_overlaps.description: Maximum allowed label overlaps. Default Inf (no limit).

use_custom_axis_label.description: Whether to use custom axis labels.

y_limit.description: Maximum y-axis value. 0 for automatic scaling.

use_auto_axis_capping.description: Automatically cap axis limits using quantiles.

auto_axis_capping_quantile.description: Quantile for automatic axis capping (0.5 to 1).

auto_axis_capping_symmetric_x.description: Use symmetric x-axis limits when auto-capping.

custom_x_axis_limits.description: Custom x-axis limits. One number for symmetric, two comma-separated for asymmetric.

x_limit_padding.description: Additional units added to x-axis limits.

y_limit_padding.description: Additional units added to y-axis limits.

plot_title_size.description: Font size for the plot title.

axis_text_size.description: Font size for axis tick labels.

point_size.description: Size of points on the volcano plot.

color_fold_change_only.description: Color for points with fold-change only.

color_significant_only.description: Color for points with significance only.

color_significant_and_fold_change.description: Color for points with both significance and fold-change.
